product_metadata.title: SPECILITE Cordless Stick Vacuum Cleaner & LED Power Brush,17KPa Powerful Cleaning 2 in 1 Handheld Upright Vacuum for Home and Car Cleaning & Wall-Mount
features: 【Super Cleaning Power】SPECILITE VACUUM CLEANER supports quiet, powerful 17kpa suction in MAX mode, suck up dust, pet hairs and crumbs in minutes. which is great on hard wood floors, carpet, walls, ceiling, and even mattress.

【Cordless & Lightweight】 Wireless design & Lightweight, with easily converts to a handheld, help you clean up high, down low and everywhere in between, 65dB noise, giving you a quiet cleaning experience.
【Pro-Cyclone System】 True pro-cyclonic suction, sucking out daily pet hair, paper debris and mites. 5th stage filtration separates more than 99% of the garbage, breathe the clean air every day.

【Detachable Battery】Large capacity 2200mAh, 22.2V lithium battery, can be used for 15min at Max speed, and your machine can be rejuvenated after years just by changing a battery. And wall-mount charger base makes charging and storage more convenient.
【What You Get】SPECILITE Stick Cordless Vacuum, carpet brush head 2-in-1 crevice brush, flexible crevice, long crevice, wall-mount charging base, an instruction and 24-HOUR SERVICE & 5-YEAR Warranty.
